title: Core Fiscal Engine — implementation
summary: Establish a trustworthy, deterministic and testable fiscal modelling foundation: canonical baseline data, a UI-free calculation module, static and multi-year projection calculations, validation, and regression tests. Tracks all implementation stories for this epic.
acceptance_criteria: Baseline values come from one canonical, validated source
All fiscal maths lives in a module testable without Streamlit
A regression test fails if default outputs change unexpectedly
The feedback model's nature and limits are documented in UI and README
pytest passes and the app boots headless
notes:
Scope (in): Canonical baseline fiscal datasets (baseline.csv); Pure, UI-free calculation module (model/fiscal_model.py); Static fiscal calculations (receipts, spending, deficit); Multi-year projection engine with feedback assumptions; Input validation and clear failure modes; Deterministic regression and unit tests; Honest documentation of the feedback model
Out of scope: Scenario presets (EPIC-002); Scoring (EPIC-003); Model persistence (EPIC-004); Cumulative capital-stock modelling (EPIC-012); Distributional detail (EPIC-013)
